title: Starbase window (WolfTrek)
layout_order: a window on the right (the base and its ghosts stay in view on the left): logo, STARBASE, line under it | X top right | four tabs MY BASE, ADD A MODULE, STOREROOM (n), YOUR OWN BUILDS | the tab content (MY BASE: picture left; name + RENAME, facts, who may dock EVERYONE FRIENDS MY GROUP ONLY ME; parts rows with page < >) | the celebration, the answer box | the bottom row (choosing a spot: PREVIOUS NEXT SPOT TURN IT ROUND BUILD IT HERE CANCEL; else the tab's orders). Ghosts in the world. Drawn by the deck, over the Station window when both are up.
